[[Briahn the Chosen]] is a [[Margonite]] [[boss]] that spawns as part of the only group of [[Kournan]]s in [[the Mirror of Lyss]]. As you approach the location indicated by the map, Briahn and his group will start their patrol and head west, to a point on the road near [[the Kodash Bazaar]]. His group will stand there for a short while before going back to their original position and repeat their patrol. Briahn's group is a very balanced group, as almost every [[profession]] is represented, making it a difficult fight for the unprepared.

* [[Vabbi]]

==Notes==
*If Briahn is accompanied by a [[Kournan Bowman]], his group will trail [[Spirit of Infuriating Heat|Spirits of Infuriating Heat]] behind.  Attacking one will cause the entire group to rush back toward you until the spirit dies.

==Trivia==
*The name of this boss is a reference to Brian, the main character of the movie [[w:Monty Python's Life of Brian|Monty Python's Life of Brian]].
